title: fix(sync): fold journal into exactly-once {{LORE_JOURNAL}} token; lint flags survivors
why:
finalizeSync replaced only the FIRST {{LORE_JOURNAL}} via String.replace(string, fn),
so a page that mentioned the token in prose as well as in the real Decision-history slot
got the journal folded into the wrong spot and SHIPPED a literal token downstream — silent
corruption. Naive replaceAll is wrong: it would dump the full journal into every match.

- lib/sync.js: extract foldJournal(text, md, {page, warn}) and validate token count:
    1  → function-form replace (unchanged happy path; $&/$$-safe regression preserved)
    0  → leave page untouched + warn (no fold slot)
    >1 → fold into the LAST occurrence (the conventional Decision-history slot, which
         always follows any prose mention), blank the earlier ones, warn. Never ships a
         literal token. finalizeSync gains an optional {warn}, defaulting to stderr.
- lib/lint.js: add lintUnfolded — flag FINALIZED pages (code_sha stamped) still holding a
  literal {{LORE_JOURNAL}}; wire into lint()/clean + CLI. Read-only, advisory, exit 0.
  Pre-sync pages (no code_sha) legitimately carry the token and are not flagged.
- commands/lint.md: document the 4th check (unfolded).
- tests: foldJournal 0/1/2-token + $-safety, finalizeSync duplicate-token integration,
  lintUnfolded unit + orchestrator + CLI. 152 -> 163, all green.

title: fix(server): serve index.html for bare directory requests
why:
The bundled Node static-server fallback (server.js, used when python is
absent) returned 404 for the advertised /site/ URL. The old logic blindly
appended `site/index.html` to any path ending in '/', turning /site/ into
site/site/index.html. python's http.server masked this by resolving
dir->index.html natively, so the bug only bit users without python on PATH.

Resolve a request that maps to a directory to <dir>/index.html, mirroring
python http.server: covers paths ending in '/' (e.g. /site/) and bare dir
names. Adds a node:test that starts the server on a temp dir with
site/index.html and asserts GET /site/ returns the index body (200).

title: fix(init): install post-commit hook when core.hooksPath is the repo default
why:
installHook treated any non-empty core.hooksPath as "managed elsewhere"
and skipped installing. But when core.hooksPath resolves to the repo's own
default hooks dir (<git-common-dir>/hooks), writing there is the unset case
and is safe. Two real repos (lore, threat-intel) had core.hooksPath pointing
at their default .git/hooks and silently got no auto-capture hook.

Now skip (return 'hookspath-set') only when the resolved core.hooksPath
differs from the resolved default hooks dir; otherwise install as usual.

Tests: two new installHook cases on real temp git repos — a different dir
still skips and writes nothing; the default .git/hooks installs the stub.
Full suite 165/165 green.
